_note: Build page parts list. 'bought' is changed only by pull request, from a Discord part update. Run python3 tools/embed_build_parts.py after editing.

v1.name: V1: line follower
v1.how: Follows a tape line on the floor. It still decides: it counts junction and door marks to pick turns for the chosen room, and stops for anything in front of it.

v2.name: V2: room scanner
v2.how: Stops to scan with the cone depth sensor on a roof servo, matches the scan to the saved map, and confirms room markers with the camera.
v2.catch: The drift car steers like a real car, so it can't spin in place. A small roof servo sweeps the sensor instead.

parts.what: World's Littlest Waymo Jaguar I-PACE diecast. The body and glass; the base and wheels may be replaced.
parts.note: On hand. Inside still to be measured.

parts.what: 1/43 4WD mini RC drift car (Dingdongwu, on Amazon). Gives the drive motor, steering servo, gears, wheels and battery.
parts.note: Steers with a front servo, so it can't turn in place. Confirm on teardown.

parts.what: The car's brain and camera. Runs motors, safety stop and marker reading.
parts.note: An ESP32-C3 is on hand for bench tests only (no camera).

parts.what: Small driver (DRV8835 class) for the drive motor. The steering servo runs straight from the ESP32.
parts.note: Skip if the donor's board can be reused.

parts.what: Protects the LiPo and charges it safely (TP4056 class).
Tiny slide switch plus a tether or pull-pin that cuts motor power without Wi-Fi.
2 amber LEDs with resistors and a small piezo sounder.
parts.note: LEDs and resistors on hand; piezo to buy.

parts.what: Steadies the power when the motors start, so the ESP32 doesn't reset.
Fits inside the shell; normal hookup wire is too thick.
Insulates the electronics from the metal diecast shell.
3D printed chassis to hold the parts, and printed markers for the rooms.
Opens the diecast to get the body off its base.
Measures motor start-up and stall current.
Gives the car its own Wi-Fi in the hallway if campus Wi-Fi blocks it.
Small reflectance sensor under the car to follow the tape.
The line the car follows.
Cheap front distance sensor (VL53L0X or VL53L1X class) to stop for obstacles.
8 x 8 depth grid in a cone of about 60 degrees, 2 to 3 m indoors. Swept on the roof servo to scan the room.
Tracks the car's heading between scans and on turns.
parts.note: Skip if the donor's gyro can be used.

parts.what: Sweeps the depth sensor on the roof, like a real Waymo's lidar. Needed because the drift car can't spin in place.
